thread:
cs_jordan: Heads-up — BrightCart escalated p99 spikes on /v1/embeddings in ap-south this morning (~06:30 IST). Seeing 2-3x tail latency, customer impact. cc @sre_amy @ryan_infra
ops-bot: ALERT: metric=p99_latency route=/v1/embeddings cluster=ap-south-1 value=1450ms threshold=1000ms
mira_oncall: Ack. Pulling dashboards and deploy history now. Any overnight infra changes?
ryan_infra: We rolled CUDA driver 12.4.1 to ap-south pool last night 02:15 UTC. Also a staged NVMe firmware push to subset of hosts (hosts tagged nvme-fw-ap-south).
sre_amy: Do we have correlation with host-level IO/QDepth or kernel preempt stats? Could be hostfs interference. @ryan_infra can you run quick iostat/perf on an affected node?
ryan_infra: Running now — commands I ran:
```
sudo iostat -x 1 15
sudo nvme log-host | tail -n 50
sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf.data sleep 10
```
Prelim: qdepth spikes to 128 on /dev/nvme0n1 during spikes, blk_util ~95%.
cs_jordan: Customer provided replay snippet and timestamps: 2025-03-11T06:31:02Z -> request id bc-req-9142, payload size ~14KB. They ran 100 concurrent small-batch embedding calls.
alex_infra: If NVMe qdepth and blk_util look hot, could be firmware scheduling change after the nvme fw. Short-term we should: 1) Reroute BrightCart to eu-west2, 2) Add model fallback to smaller embed model, 3) Throttle concurrency for that customer to 40 rps. Can we apply those quickly?
mira_oncall: I'm applying traffic override to route BrightCart -> eu-west2 via customer routing feature, and adding concurrency rate limit on their API key. Pushing now.
sre_amy: Plan for infra: roll back CUDA driver on a small canary subset of affected hosts, and take nvme-fw-offline for nodes with highest qdepth to vendor. Need bisect to know which component caused regression. Also collect kernel oops/dmesg and nvme error logs.
ryan_infra: Started a rolling kexec rollback to driver 12.3 on 4 canary nodes (host ids: ap-south-1-{203,204,209,215}). Will monitor.
ops-bot: ACTION: routing_override applied to BrightCart (eu-west2), rate_limit=40rps, fallback_model=text-embed-small
cs_jordan: Customer acked — after reroute their p99 dropped to ~180ms (from ~900ms peak). They confirm degraded but usable. Thanks team.
sre_amy: Good mitigation. Next: schedule full bisect tomorrow 03:00 UTC, collect perf snapshots (iostat, nvme logs, perf, dmesg) from affected hosts, open vendor ticket if nvme errors correlate. Update CS and ETA by EOD.
cs_jordan: Noted. I'll tell BrightCart we're routing and will follow up after RCA. Closing customer-facing loop for now.
ryan_infra: Saving all captures to /var/log/incidents/1735550123/ and attaching to the incident. Will post reproduction steps and exact commands after analysis.
cs_jordan: +1. Please tag me when RCA is ready.
sre_amy: assigning follow-ups: #1 bisect driver vs nvme fw (ryan_infra), #2 vendor escalation (alex_infra), #3 postmortem writeup (mira_oncall). :white_check_mark:
